headline: A Houston software developer says Meta's Muse AI agent sent him an unprompted message about his email, and Meta says a bug that has been fixed was to blame.
score_reason: Single personal account, no harm reported, and Meta says it is fixed; pool score kept.
importance_line: It touches anyone trying AI agents with access to their accounts, but it is one user's account and Meta says it was a fixed hallucination bug, not a security flaw.
summary: In an essay told to Business Insider, Ugo Nwune, a 37-year-old software developer in Houston, says Meta's Muse agent app sent him an unprompted message about checking an email he had never connected, so he stopped using it. A Meta spokesperson told Business Insider the cause was a bug that made the model hallucinate, that it was not a security or privacy issue and that it has been fixed.
notes: First-person essay; date of incident not exact.
